note: While a reschedule is open, parse_intents reads "let's go with Dr. Chen" as a book intent (the book pattern has "with dr") and misses "moved" (the reschedule pattern is \bmove\b), so route() treats the line as a pivot to a new booking, proposes "Shall I book it?", and books on the yes. Each of the three alone clears every probe. Recorded in Promise Boundary (Lab 23) notes as driver bug 2 (x0195), frozen with the driver, removed from the agent's workspace.
